name: Enrica Pérez
bio: Lima, Peru, 1976. Enrica Pérez Matos studied Communication Sciences. Her short film "Taxista" (2007) won several awards, including Best Fiction Short Film and Best Narrative Short Film in Peru and New York. She also received the Adrienne Shelly Award for Best Female Director and the Someone to Watch Award from CineWomen NY. In 2008, she enrolled at the French film school La Fémis and filmed her latest short film, "De Mon Côte," produced and co-written with French filmmakers. "Climas" is her first feature film.
